• "Let Gramob find a driver later" closes the scheduled-ride request on the drivers (API, driver and passenger, Android and iOS) — when a passenger left Find a driver with "find a driver later", the "Scheduled ride request" dialog stayed up on the drivers it had been sent to. New POST passenger/rides/:id/find-later leaves the booking as it is, sends ride:scheduled_request_closed to every driver the request went to (except one re-confirming a moved time) and logs SCHEDULED_FIND_LATER; it returns {closed: 0} once the ride has a driver or is out to bidding. The driver apps close that ride's dialog, do not raise it again this session, and keep the ride on Requests to answer. The passenger apps call it on "find a driver later" and leave for Rides after the answer or after 4 seconds, whichever is first. New tests: find-later.spec.ts (API) and ScheduledRequestClosedTest (driver). iOS docs updated (api-contract, driver and passenger inventories).
